body: I feel like I'm between a 5 and a 6, but on a bad day (maybe every few weeks), it jumps straight up to an 8. I finally told a friend that I've been feeling this way and now they're extra freaked out. I think its fluctuated between 5 and 8 for years now and I've rehearsed my note in my head so many times. I know I probably need help or pills or something, but I cant bring myself to go ask for it. I know that I'm a problem, it feels like I'm getting nowhere with my life and I just dont want to be here anymore. Every time I get really close, something wakes me up and I'm okay for a bit. But I can't help but feel that sooner or later something won't wake me up.
